reader.requirement: At --std 85 an explicitly referenced paragraph-name duplicated within its section must be refused, a paragraph qualified by section-name must not admit the word SECTION, an unqualified paragraph-name must resolve to its own section's paragraph when referenced from within that section, and a paragraph or section of another (containing or contained) program must not be referenceable.
reader.edition-search: grep of ProcedureTableBuilder.cs, ProcedureNameMap.cs and StatementValidation.cs#RejectAmbiguousProcedureName for CobolVersion|DialectLevel|Edition.Edition|Year|ConstructRegistry: only Edition.At (diagnostic cursor). The grammar's procedureName admits reservedGatedWord (the per-edition reserved-word gate, not specific to this rule).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses exercise legal qualified and in-section unqualified references and an unreferenced duplicate; not exercised at 85: refusal of a referenced in-section duplicate, the SECTION word after the qualifier, and cross-program procedure references

probes.printed: B-X B-Y C-X A-Y B-X B-Y B-Y B-Z END
probes.expected: P-X IN S-B / OF S-C reach each copy; unqualified P-Y inside S-B reaches B-Y and inside S-A reaches A-Y; THRU and GO TO qualified

probes.printed: COBOL2122 PERFORM 'P-DUP': that paragraph-name is declared 2 times within section 'S-B' ... explicitly referenced here
probes.expected: refused: a referenced paragraph-name must not be duplicated within a section

probes.printed: 85 and 2023: COBOL0307 unexpected 'SECTION' at PERFORM P-OK OF S-B SECTION
probes.expected: refused: the word SECTION must not appear

probes.printed: COBOL1639 PERFORM 'INNER-P' names no procedure (line 6); GO TO 'OUTER-P' names no procedure (line 14)
probes.expected: refused: a paragraph-name of another program may not be referenced

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.6  (4.3.8.1 Qualification)  the text is in SRL2.6

reader.notes: ResolveProcedureWord is the one resolution for every procedure-name operand: qualified looks in the named section's map, unqualified prefers the current section, and an in-section duplicate returns an ambiguity reported as COBOL2122; the maps are per source element so another program's names resolve to nothing. The grammar has no SECTION after the qualifier, so it is a parse refusal at every edition.

refuter.evidence: r5pn at 85 gave these results. PERFORM P-D from SA, where P-D is in SB and SC: COBOL2121 (not unique). PERFORM P-E OF SB, written qualified but duplicated within SB: COBOL2122. PERFORM IN-S, a section of the contained program, and PERFORM SC from the contained program, a section of the containing program: COBOL1639 'names no procedure'. The reader probed paragraphs only; I probed section-names. r6nosec: duplicated paragraphs in a Procedure Division with no sections, explicitly referenced, drew COBOL2121. r2sup: unqualified PY inside SB, and PX IN SA, both reached the right copies. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.6 ... the text is in SRL2.6'.
